product_one_liner.value: Perceptyx provides an AI-powered employee-experience platform for organizations and their people teams to gather employee feedback, analyze workforce insights, and turn them into action and capability building.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes an AI-powered employee-experience platform that turns employee insight into action, behavior change, and workforce capability; the solution description identifies organizational employee-experience use cases.

pricing_page.notes: The recent pricing check reports no pricing page and a 404 at the pricing route; the homepage directs visitors to talk to an expert rather than listing prices.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Perceptyx customer-story pages identify Avery Dennison and American Woodmark as customers. | named_customers.0: The customer story explicitly identifies Avery Dennison. | named_customers.1: The customer story explicitly identifies American Woodmark.

employee_band.notes: Revelio Labs reports 399 employees as of June 2026, placing the company in the 201–500 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The cited company profile names Temecula as Perceptyx’s headquarters city. | hq_country: The company profile states that Perceptyx is headquartered in Temecula, California, United States.

founded_year.notes: The company profile identifies Perceptyx as founded in 2003; the investor profile independently gives the same year.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index is a general employee-experience, research, and company-content blog. The clear product-build/ML engineering article found is the sentiment-model post, co-authored by a product manager and the AI and data engineering lead; the index and author record do not establish a second engineer-authored build post, so it does not meet the two-post threshold.

public_docs.notes: The Perceptyx developer portal provides an API introduction and multiple linked guides, reference topics, and API endpoints, satisfying the public documentation criterion.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Perceptyx’s live careers board lists a Sales Development Representative and VP, Strategic Expansion, neither an AI, ML, or data-science role.

model_provider.value: OpenAI and Google (for optional generative-AI features)
model_provider.notes: Perceptyx’s AI Model Governance overview says optional generative-AI features are powered by OpenAI and Google.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Perceptyx’s security page explicitly says it is ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II compliant; those are the two requested certifications named there. | compliance_certs.0: The security page names ISO 27001. | compliance_certs.1: The security page names SOC 2 Type II.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: PitchBook labels the company’s latest financing deal type as a debt refinancing. | funding_date: PitchBook gives the latest financing date as July 1, 2024, which corresponds to 2024-07. | funding_amount_usd: PitchBook’s Perceptyx profile lists the latest financing as a USD 80 million debt refinancing dated July 1, 2024.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest financing shown is dated July 2024, earlier than the 18-month window beginning May 9, 2025; there is no later financing shown in the funding profile.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live careers board lists an Enterprise Sales Development Representative opening, which qualifies as SDR hiring.

launched_6mo.notes: Perceptyx announced the launch of Perceptyx Anywhere on September 29, 2026, within the six months before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The current leadership page lists the executive team. The dated C-suite appointment announcements located were in May and June 2025, before the 12-month window beginning 2025-11-09; no in-window executive join or departure was found. This negative conclusion rests on the current team roster and available announcements.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: The current VP, Strategic Expansion posting says expansion forecasts are maintained in Salesforce, directly indicating use of that CRM. | crm_stack_signal.0: The job posting explicitly names Salesforce for keeping expansion forecasts accurate.
